info.name: Aadrash Sah
info.title: Founder & Digital Creator
info.heroDescription: I create modern digital experiences through web design, graphic design, video editing, branding, animation, and creative technology.
aboutParagraphs: I'm Aadrash Sah, a passionate Digital Creator and Founder of NEW NEPAL DIGITAL. I enjoy creating modern websites, digital designs, promotional content, videos, branding materials, and creative digital experiences.
My goal is to combine creativity and technology to create professional digital experiences that help businesses and brands stand out.
